Looks like someone took a trip to the springs, it does.'' :'''Knowing Falls:''' ''Wanna tell your paw what happened?'' :'''Little Fish:''' ''I fell into the river...'' :'''Knowing Falls:''' ''Took a good swim, did you? Good weather for it.'' :'''Little Fish:''' ''Maw wants to make her special soup for Torpor. Thought I'd catch her a few fish, is all...'' :'''Knowing Falls:''' ''All by yourself? Brave, you are. Where's your fishing rod?'' :'''Little Fish:''' ''I...lost it to the current.'' :'''Knowing Falls:''' ''Ha! Happens to us all, it does. Let me get my own. We'll catch Maw enough for Torpor.'' :'''Little Fish:''' ''Okay.'' ;At [[Deft Lahar's Abode]] :'''Misty Lavender:''' ''I've already started stockpiling honey for Torpor. Nothing beats a spoonful of honey on a cold winter's day.'' :'''Torrid Gaze:''' ''My, my... Waking up with honey in my fur is not my favorite thing.'' :'''Torrid Gaze:''' ''Instead, I've got berries, nuts, and fish—a little bit of everything. The salmon this season has been utterly divine!'' :'''Misty Lavender:''' ''It's a testament to the abundance of our land. We're truly blessed.'' ;Around a campfire south of [[Deft Lahar's Abode]] :'''Ashmaker:''' ''Tonight... Something special for our [[Astral Ward|sky watcher]] friends.'' :'''Ashmaker:''' ''Have any of you heard the story of the [[Haar Mire|bog]]'s heiress?'' :'''Eithine:''' ''No, I don't think I have.'' :'''Ashmaker:''' ''(clears throat)'' :'''Ashmaker:''' ''In the murk, [[the Bog Queen]] stirs. Her hands and teeth nip at your fur.'' :'''Ashmaker:''' ''Don't let her voice into your thoughts, or else her screams shall make them rot.'' :'''Ashmaker:''' ''So plug your ears and clean your paws. Don't let her pick apart your flaws.'' :'''Ashmaker:''' ''You draw your spear... She'll hide beneath! Steady now—she'll sense your heat.'' :'''Ashmaker:''' ''So long as dead shall fail to rise, that wicked queen bears no surprise.'' :'''Ashmaker:''' ''Listen close, don't say a word. [[Valravn]] alone know what you heard.'' :'''Ashmaker:''' ''Now close your eyes, and she'll be gone.
